name: selfdriven.codes
description: Human trust infrastructure agent. Generates unique trust-establishment codes, binds them cryptographically to KERI AIDs and ACDC session credentials, and orchestrates delivery through a distributed network of trusted human couriers. Establishes root trust between humans across compromised digital channels.

capabilities.name: Generate trust code
capabilities.description: Generate a human-readable trust code bound to a session SAID and KERI AID

capabilities.name: Verify trust code
capabilities.description: Verify a code against its SAID, session binding, and TTL

output.courierPath: array of courier AIDs that handled this code

capabilities.name: Rotate trust code
capabilities.description: Issue a fresh code for an existing session — invalidates the previous code

capabilities.name: Dispatch code via courier
capabilities.description: Request delivery of a trust code through a human courier pathway

output.state: pending | assigned | acknowledged | in_transit | delivered | verified | disputed

capabilities.name: Check dispatch status
capabilities.description: Retrieve current state of a courier dispatch

output.trail: array of state transitions with timestamps and ixn events

output.couriers: array of courier profiles with AIDs, credentials, reputation, availability

capabilities.name: Attest to courier interaction
capabilities.description: Record an attestation about a courier after a delivery — feeds the reputation layer

layers.name: Cryptographic
layers.function: Code generation, session SAID binding, signature integrity

layers.name: Identity
layers.function: KERI AIDs, ACDC role credentials, KEL continuity

layers.name: Courier
layers.function: Human transport — physical, relay, split-trust, proximity, community

layers.name: Reputation
layers.function: Courier trust scoring, interaction histories, Cardano anchoring

layers.name: Session
layers.function: Temporary interaction trust, replay prevention via TTL

layers.name: Governance
layers.function: Rules, delegation, append-only ixn audit trails

courierTypes.name: Community Members
courierTypes.description: Verified neighbourhood participants with established local reputation

courierTypes.name: Licensed Professionals
courierTypes.description: Notaries, solicitors, accredited agents with ACDC credentials, often anchored to GLEIF vLEI

courierTypes.name: Governance Participants
courierTypes.description: Members of validated trust networks with cryptographic attestations

courierTypes.name: Organisation Representatives
courierTypes.description: Designated trust officers under KERI-delegated AIDs with scoped, time-limited authority

deliveryModels.name: Physical delivery
deliveryModels.description: Courier physically provides the code in person — highest assurance

deliveryModels.name: Relay delivery
deliveryModels.description: Code transferred through a chain of trusted intermediaries

deliveryModels.name: Split trust
deliveryModels.description: Multiple couriers deliver fragments; no single courier holds the full code

deliveryModels.name: Proximity
deliveryModels.description: Codes exchanged only within geographic boundaries — geofenced trust

deliveryModels.name: Community
deliveryModels.description: Trusted local organisations act as delivery nodes
